name: a tall thin figure made of coats
description: A figure stands against the wall, built out of hanging coats and nothing else, no face, no hands, the shoulders far too high, and it is unmistakably paying attention to you.
looks: The coats hang perfectly still. There is no draught in here and there would need to be.
It has no obvious front. It is looking at you.
It has moved. You would swear to it and you would be wrong.
says: I will be here when it wears off.
emotes: {it} settles half an inch, the way hanging cloth settles, and is somehow closer.
A sleeve of {it} swings gently and stops.
{it} inclines what would be a head, if it had one, in your direction.
asks: Are you all right? You have been standing there a while.
Do you remember taking anything? Genuinely, do you?
Would you rather I waited outside?
